verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://qdrant.tech/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured summary of Qdrant, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The GitHub repo also ships agent skills that bring Qdrant guidance (quantization, sharding, hybrid search and more) into AI coding assistants, which adds agent-oriented material. missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the docs .md variant returns 404), independent or hands-on reports of agents actually using llms.txt or the skills.
